tasks.description: Writes redacted copies of support tickets following a redaction policy. Use when asked to redact the personal data in a folder of support tickets.
tasks.intent: Redact personal data in support tickets according to the policy.

tasks.description: Inventories the personal data types in support tickets with counts per type and the policy action. Use when asked for a PII inventory of a folder of support tickets.
tasks.intent: Inventory personal data types in support tickets without reproducing values.

tasks.description: Logs where redactions apply in each support ticket by line number and type, with totals per queue. Use when asked for a redaction log for a folder of support tickets.
tasks.intent: Log required redactions per ticket and queue without personal values.
